svg.title: baileys-cc-bridge
svg.desc: A WhatsApp group on movie night. Ben says there is nothing to eat, you ask if anyone wants to order, and Rina wants pizza with extra cheese. Mochi Bot, an AI agent with its own number, reacts with an OK hand, sends a screenshot of the pizza cart it filled on GrabFood and asks whether to order. You say go, and it confirms the order, signed Assisted by Claude. Next to the chat, the agent as a robot at its computer, ordering on a food delivery site.
svg.text: movie starts at 8 and there's nothing to eat 😩
Cart's ready on GrabFood. Order it?
